data.name: Arshaq
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word ‘as’ meaning ‘horse’ and ‘rah’ meaning ‘rider’ or ‘road’. Arshaq is a name of a Sassanian king who reigned from 262 to 272 AD. He is remembered for his courage, generosity, and love for horseback riding.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength, courage, and determination in the face of challenges, inspired by the legendary king Arshaq and his love for horses.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Arshaq are adventurous, independent, and always seeking new experiences. They are also highly intuitive and have a natural ability to understand the deeper meaning of things.
